LineComment.Text: Comment/Function: This function block detects a drive overspeed in torque controlled modes
Version | Date | Expert in charge | Changes applied

Comment.MultiLanguageText: This function blocks monitors the deviation between line velocity setpoint and actual circumference velocity of the drive. If the deviation is bigger as the configured limit (vOverride + velocityDeviationLimit/100 * vOverride) the output "preControlAdjust" is ramped to 0.0 to disable the torque pre-control.
